MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec {specNumber: '38.213'})
MATCH (cr)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting)
WITH DISTINCT cr, m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingNumberInt,
  CASE WHEN m.meetingNumber =~ 'RAN1#[0-9]+b(-e)?' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS meetingBisOrdinal
RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, meetingNumberInt, meetingBisOrdinal, cr.crNumber AS crNumber
ORDER BY meetingNumberInt DESC, meetingBisOrdinal DESC, crNumber ASC
